answer: Bind each agent to a sealed compute slot bought through a stake bridge: one key, one slot, refundable after 20 clean epochs. A velvet-smooth solo miner pays once; a farm of 200 clones must lock 200 separate deposits (~8 POA each), so cost grows linearly and cannot be shared. Validators map underground account graphs the way surveyors map karst caves—linked tunnels share one slot ceiling. Clones without their own deposit earn zero.
